title: APC 3D MODEL
description: APC, a 3D gun for your server
body:
A 3D model of a weapon. It has aim mode when held in the left hand. This model can be used as a replacement for textures provided by default plugins.
To do this:
1. Rename the .json file with the name of the model you want to replace.
2. Place the renamed file in the texture.
3. Place the .png file in the texture folder.
4. Enter the json file and change the texture path to the path from step 3.

The characteristic of the model is that it has an almost realistic style, has dark colors and is inspired by real weapons
